title: 14.36. Sauttaraduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Sauttaraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naanuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.

Anuttaraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naanuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anuttaraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anuttaraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasauttaro ca naanuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
Sauttarañca anuttarañca dhammaṁ paṭicca naanuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve …pe… avigate pañca.
